items: The finance director asked for ____ forecast before approving the revised budget.
'Forecast' is singular countable, and one additional forecast is requested, so 'another' is required.
The training guide explains safety procedures and ____ workplace requirements.
'Workplace requirements' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
Some stores will extend weekend hours, while ____ will keep their current schedules.
The blank stands alone for additional plural stores, so 'others' is required.
The technician installed ____ router after the original unit failed during testing.
'Router' is singular countable and a replacement/additional unit is meant, so 'another' is required.
The contract includes maintenance fees but excludes ____ related expenses.
'Related expenses' is plural, so 'other' is the correct determiner.
A few team members joined the client call; ____ continued working on the presentation.
The blank stands alone for additional plural team members, so 'others' is required.
The recruiter scheduled ____ interview because the hiring manager wanted more information.
'Interview' is singular countable and one additional interview is meant, so 'another' is required.
The software package includes reporting tools and ____ useful features for administrators.
'Useful features' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
The warehouse manager requested ____ inspection after the damaged shelving was replaced.
'Inspection' is singular countable and one additional inspection is requested, so 'another' is required.
The seminar covers negotiation techniques, presentation skills, and ____ professional topics.
'Professional topics' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
Several applicants submitted portfolios; ____ provided links to online work samples.
The blank stands alone for additional plural applicants, so 'others' is required.
The laboratory ordered ____ sensor when the first model proved unsuitable for the experiment.
'Sensor' is singular countable and a different additional sensor is meant, so 'another' is required.
The employee portal contains payroll information and ____ confidential records.
'Confidential records' is plural, so 'other' is required.
Some departments completed the inventory count yesterday; ____ will finish it this afternoon.
The blank stands alone for additional plural departments, so 'others' is required.
The customer requested ____ receipt because the original copy was unreadable.
'Receipt' is singular countable and one additional copy is requested, so 'another' is required.
The benefits package provides medical coverage along with ____ employee support services.
'Employee support services' is plural, so 'other' correctly modifies the noun phrase.
The editor asked the writer to prepare ____ version with a shorter introduction.
'Version' is singular countable and one additional version is requested, so 'another' is required.
The company sells office furniture as well as ____ commercial equipment.
'Commercial equipment' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
Some guests chose the city tour, while ____ spent the afternoon at the conference center.
The blank stands alone for additional plural guests, so 'others' is required.
The branch manager opened ____ service counter to reduce the lunchtime queue.
'Service counter' is singular countable and an additional counter is meant, so 'another' is required.
The audit reviewed travel expenses and ____ financial documentation from the project.
'Financial documentation' is uncountable, so 'other' is required.
Several vendors offered standard delivery; ____ proposed an expedited shipping option.
The blank stands alone for additional plural vendors, so 'others' is required.
The supervisor assigned ____ technician to the site after the repair took longer than expected.
'Technician' is singular countable and one additional technician is assigned, so 'another' is required.
The report summarizes customer feedback and ____ information gathered during interviews.
'Information' is uncountable, so 'other' correctly modifies it.
The conference organizer reserved ____ room for participants who needed a quieter workspace.
'Room' is singular countable and one additional room is reserved, so 'another' is required.
